generic-16-encoder-performance.label: Generic 16-Encoder Performance Brain

pages.label: Global Brain
pages.summary: Top-level live-performance intent: depth, macro selection, safety, and preview.

controls.label: Preview Depth
controls.notes: Scales staged mutation amount before any dry-run or send decision.

controls.label: Variation Amount
controls.notes: Controls how far the next generated idea moves from the captured anchor.

controls.label: Density
controls.notes: Controls how many eligible parameters are touched by staged moves.

controls.label: Bias
controls.notes: Tilts generated moves darker, brighter, tighter, looser, or grittier.

controls.label: Kit Core
controls.notes: Selects the full-kit safe discovery macro as the staged direction.

controls.label: Hard Groove
controls.notes: Selects dry pressure and source movement for OXI-driven patterns.

controls.label: Industrial
controls.notes: Selects metallic pressure and controlled grit while preserving recovery.

controls.label: Dub Pressure
controls.notes: Selects darker delay/reverb pressure as the staged direction.

controls.label: Transition
controls.notes: Selects a bridge/fill move that remains recoverable through Home.

controls.label: Home
controls.notes: Returns staged intent to the captured safe kit.

controls.label: Preview
controls.notes: Reviews the next move without opening ports or sending MIDI.

controls.label: Dry Run
controls.notes: Simulates readiness and blocked actions before hardware is armed.

controls.label: Stage
controls.notes: Stages the selected macro and depth into the live queue.

controls.label: Save Journal
controls.notes: Marks the reviewed result as a favorite accident for later replay.

controls.label: Undo
controls.notes: Targets the previous safe reviewed state, not raw controller rollback.

controls.label: Readiness
controls.notes: Summarizes whether staged intent is safe, blocked, or requires review.

pages.label: Rytm Pads 1-4
pages.summary: Kick-anchor and first percussion lane controls.

controls.label: Pad 1 Lock
controls.notes: Pad 1 remains the kick anchor by default.

controls.label: Pad 1 Body
controls.notes: Small kick-body movement only.

controls.label: Pad 1 Grit
controls.notes: Tiny snap/drive moves for protected kick pressure.

controls.label: Pad 1 Filter
controls.notes: Safe filter shade, never the main source of movement.

controls.label: Pad 2 Source
controls.notes: Secondary lane source movement.

controls.label: Pad 2 Density
controls.notes: How often Pad 2 participates in generated moves.

controls.label: Pad 2 Bias
controls.notes: Tighter, looser, brighter, darker, or grittier Pad 2 bias.

controls.label: Pad 2 FX
controls.notes: Delay, reverb, and drive influence.

controls.label: Pad 3 Source
controls.notes: SY/synth source movement for bass or accent behavior.

controls.label: Pad 3 Morph
controls.notes: Wave/balance style movement where machine-safe.

controls.label: Pad 3 Density
controls.notes: Participation density for Pad 3.

controls.label: Pad 3 Bias
controls.notes: Pad 3 grit, looseness, or brightness tilt.

controls.label: Pad 4 Source
controls.notes: Body/accent lane source movement.

controls.label: Pad 4 Body
controls.notes: Pressure and decay movement for the accent layer.

controls.label: Pad 4 Density
controls.notes: Participation density for Pad 4.

controls.label: Pad 4 Bias
controls.notes: Pad 4 tighter, looser, or grittier tilt.

pages.label: Rytm Pads 5-8
pages.summary: SRC-first tom and mid-kit lanes with light filter and no LFO craziness.

controls.label: Pad 5 Source
controls.notes: SRC remains the important lane even when filter/LFO stay quiet.

controls.label: Pad 5 Density
controls.notes: Participation density for Pad 5.

controls.label: Pad 5 Drive
controls.notes: Drive/delay/reverb only; no broad filter or LFO movement.

controls.label: Pad 5 Lock
controls.notes: Allows Jose-style local exclusion without removing Pad 5 from the product.

controls.label: Pad 6 Source
controls.notes: Tom/source movement is the main performance value for Pad 6.

controls.label: Pad 6 Filter
controls.notes: Light filter movement only.

controls.label: Pad 6 FX
controls.notes: Delay, reverb, and drive influence.

controls.label: Pad 6 Density
controls.notes: How strongly Pad 6 joins tom/source discovery.

controls.label: Pad 7 Source
controls.notes: Tom/source movement is the main performance value for Pad 7.

controls.label: Pad 7 Filter
controls.notes: Light filter movement only.

controls.label: Pad 7 FX
controls.notes: Delay, reverb, and drive influence.

controls.label: Pad 7 Density
controls.notes: How strongly Pad 7 joins tom/source discovery.

controls.label: Pad 8 Source
controls.notes: Tom/source movement is the main performance value for Pad 8.

controls.label: Pad 8 Filter
controls.notes: Light filter movement only.

controls.label: Pad 8 FX
controls.notes: Delay, reverb, and drive influence.

controls.label: Pad 8 Density
controls.notes: How strongly Pad 8 joins tom/source discovery.

pages.label: Rytm Pads 9-12
pages.summary: Top percussion, cymbal, and optional Pad 12 controls with SRC-first policy.

controls.label: Pad 9 Source
controls.notes: SRC remains first; filter and LFO stay de-emphasized.

controls.label: Pad 9 Density
controls.notes: Top-lane participation density.

controls.label: Pad 9 Bright
controls.notes: Bright or dark tilt without filter-page wandering.

controls.label: Pad 9 FX
controls.notes: Delay, reverb, and drive only.

controls.label: Pad 10 Source
controls.notes: SRC remains first; filter and LFO stay de-emphasized.

controls.label: Pad 10 Density
controls.notes: Top-lane participation density.

controls.label: Pad 10 Bright
controls.notes: Bright or dark tilt without filter-page wandering.

controls.label: Pad 10 FX
controls.notes: Delay, reverb, and drive only.

controls.label: Pad 11 Source
controls.notes: SRC remains first; filter and LFO stay de-emphasized.

controls.label: Pad 11 Density
controls.notes: Top-lane participation density.

controls.label: Pad 11 Texture
controls.notes: Bright, gritty, or darker tilt for noise/cymbal behavior.

controls.label: Pad 11 FX
controls.notes: Delay, reverb, and drive only.

controls.label: Pad 12 Source
controls.notes: Pad 12 stays available for other users even if Jose often leaves it out.

controls.label: Pad 12 Density
controls.notes: Optional Pad 12 participation density.

controls.label: Pad 12 FX
controls.notes: Delay, reverb, and drive influence.

controls.label: Pad 12 Lock
controls.notes: Quickly de-emphasize or exclude Pad 12 without deleting it from the profile.

pages.label: Analog Four Tracks

controls.label: T1 Macro Depth
controls.notes: Track 1 macro depth for bass foundation movement.

controls.label: T1 Tone
controls.notes: Track 1 oscillator/filter tilt.

controls.label: T1 Space
controls.notes: Track 1 delay/reverb influence.

controls.label: T1 Density
controls.notes: Track 1 participation density.

controls.label: T2 Macro Depth
controls.notes: Track 2 macro depth for stab pressure.

controls.label: T2 Tone
controls.notes: Track 2 oscillator/filter tilt.

controls.label: T2 Space
controls.notes: Track 2 delay/reverb influence.

controls.label: T2 Density
controls.notes: Track 2 participation density.

controls.label: T3 Macro Depth
controls.notes: Track 3 macro depth for motion accent lanes.

controls.label: T3 Motion
controls.notes: Track 3 LFO/pulse motion preview intent.

controls.label: T3 Space
controls.notes: Track 3 delay/reverb influence.

controls.label: T3 Density
controls.notes: Track 3 participation density.

controls.label: T4 Macro Depth
controls.notes: Track 4 macro depth for air/noise lanes.

controls.label: T4 Texture
controls.notes: Track 4 noise/texture preview intent.

controls.label: T4 Space
controls.notes: Track 4 delay/reverb influence.

controls.label: T4 Density
controls.notes: Track 4 participation density.

pages.label: Style Crates + Queue
pages.summary: Browse mutation crates and stage a live set story without active dispatch.

controls.label: Hard Groove
controls.notes: Selects the Hard Groove crate.

controls.label: Dark Hypnotic
controls.notes: Selects the Dark Hypnotic crate.

controls.label: Industrial
controls.notes: Selects the Industrial Warehouse crate.

controls.label: Dub Pressure
controls.notes: Selects the Dub Pressure crate.

controls.label: Peak Time
controls.notes: Selects the Peak Time crate.

controls.label: Transition
controls.notes: Selects Transition / Build moves.

controls.label: Home Reset
controls.notes: Selects recovery and reset moves.

controls.label: Saved Accidents
controls.notes: Browses favorite saved mutation results.

controls.label: Queue Current
controls.notes: Stages the highlighted move as current.

controls.label: Queue Next 1
controls.notes: Stages the first upcoming move.

controls.label: Queue Next 2
controls.notes: Stages the second upcoming move.

controls.label: Queue Next 3
controls.notes: Stages the third upcoming move.

controls.label: Skip Move
controls.notes: Skips the highlighted staged move locally.

controls.label: Clear Queue
controls.notes: Clears staged moves locally.

controls.label: Move Energy
controls.notes: Biases upcoming move energy.

controls.label: Move Risk
controls.notes: Biases upcoming move risk before review.

pages.label: Snapshot Recovery + Journal
pages.summary: Captured-kit recovery, snapshots, and favorite mutation journaling.

controls.label: Capture Kit
controls.notes: Represents kit/resnapshot intent; no SysEx receive happens here.

controls.label: Base
controls.notes: Returns to captured anchor intent.

controls.label: Snapshot 1
controls.notes: Stages snapshot slot 1 for review.

controls.label: Snapshot 2
controls.notes: Stages snapshot slot 2 for review.

controls.label: Snapshot 3
controls.notes: Stages snapshot slot 3 for review.

controls.label: Snapshot 4
controls.notes: Stages snapshot slot 4 for review.

controls.label: Snapshot 5
controls.notes: Stages snapshot slot 5 for review.

controls.label: Snapshot 6
controls.notes: Stages snapshot slot 6 for review.

controls.label: Journal Save
controls.notes: Saves the reviewed result as a favorite mutation.

controls.label: Journal Vary
controls.notes: Stages a variation of a saved mutation.

controls.label: Journal Tag
controls.notes: Marks a journal entry with style tags.

controls.label: Journal Recall
controls.notes: Stages a saved mutation result for review.

controls.label: Undo
controls.notes: Recovers the previous staged state.

controls.label: Redo
controls.notes: Restores the next reviewed state if available.

controls.label: Compare
controls.notes: Compares staged state against base in the passive UI.

controls.label: Panic Home
controls.notes: Always points back to the captured safe anchor.

generic-16-encoder-performance.safety_summary: passive mapping only; translates controller gestures into reviewed RytmRandomizer intent, not active MIDI sends
blocked_active_actions: MIDI learn or raw CC capture
